Classic Jackpot Options

Create and run what we call our classic jackpots. Set these up and they'll run for as long (or as short!) as you need them to.

Each jackpot can use one of our three jackpot models:
Average amount: The winnings will be around this amount, give or take.
Fixed amount: Each winning will be this amount and only this amount.
Maximum amount The jackpot will never win higher than this amount, but could be lower.

These models are perfect for any long-running promotion, or over a series of games or events such as a Premier League season, or over all your table games. Or alternatively have a jackpot only for deposits to encourage players to deposit more. Remember the more they spend, the better the chance of winning!

All jackpots can be configured to be self-funding, or feel free to seed them with marketing funds for that extra boost to your players.

Choose your frequency for winning

Expand on the Classic Jackpot and limit your jackpots to a specific time frequency.
Do you find that you don't have many players at the start of the week?
Then setup a Jackpot that can only be won Monday morning. The more spins, the more chances of winning!

Or how about a Pay-Day jackpot?
Set a jackpot up for the 25th of each month and give your players a chance to boost their income!

Urgent and immediate, perfect for sports!

Perfect for time-sensitive events, the Must Drop jackpot will guarantee a jackpot win within the defined time frame.

Want to boost in-play bets during that big game Saturday night?
Setup a Must Drop jackpot during the game and every bet on that match has a chance to win.

Or what about that popular TV show?
Get some third screen action going and run a Must Drop jackpot during the TV show, allowing your players to enjoy the show, enjoy your games and win big!
